ModMetaData.name: Better Orbital Traders
ModMetaData.author: Coldcrow
ModMetaData.description:
Better Orbital Traders is a powerful re-balance of vanilla orbital traders plus eight new orbital trader types, including an orbital scrapyard that buys ANYTHING. Get rid of your junk!
Base game orbital traders carry far more silver (within reason) and their stock has been re-balanced to match the size of a ship and the amount of goods it should carry. Late game and wealthy colonies get a trade partner that can keep up, and early game colonies get more options.
Features: - Much more silver on every base game (and DLC) orbital trader - Re-balanced base game trader stock: the bulk goods ship carries every textile and raw resource by the thousand, gold and jade included, and other ships get tweaked items and quantities - Orbital scrapyard: buys ALL of your items - Orbital ecosphere: plant and animal products, livestock, pets, uncommon wildlife, rare seeds - Organ farm: buys and sells humans and human accessories (organs and prosthetics), plus genepacks, archite capsules, hemogen, and deathrest serum with Biotech - Narcotics dealer: smuggles every kind of drug and medicine down from wealthy glitterworlds - Autonomous archive: books, modded ones included, and techprints, plus tomes (Anomaly) and maps (Odyssey) - Orbital shipbreaker (Odyssey): gravlite panels, vacstone, obsidian, shuttle engines, components, and bulk metals. Buys gravship upgrades - Void peddler (Anomaly): bioferrite, shards, tomes, dread leather, serums, cultist gear, deadlife shells. Buys revenant spines, and void sculptures with Better Tradable Items - Guild flagship (Odyssey): never arrives on its own. Request it from the comms console as a Guild ally for more silver than any other ship and a slice of every other ship's stock - Odyssey: all eight ships belong to the Traders Guild, like the vanilla orbital traders. Request them from the comms console, trade and gift with them for Guild goodwill, and expect them to stay away while the Guild is hostile - Combat Extended: the flagship stocks CE ammo, FSX, prometheum, and turrets like CE's combat supplier, the shipbreaker salvages turrets, heavy ammo, and FSX, and both buy ammo and turrets back
This mod does not touch ground traders or traders added by other mods. Only base game (and DLC) orbital traders, and the ones this mod adds.
Works with Combat Extended in any load order; the CE stock above loads only when CE is active.
XML only, RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7, no DLC required, safe to add or remove mid-save.
